description:
Returns stocks most recommended by the best-performing analysts (by analyst track record) in one market.

    Args:
        num: Number of results
        sector: Sector filter (financial, healthcare, technology, etc.) or empty for all
        country: 'US', 'Canada', 'UK', 'Germany', 'France', 'Spain', 'Italy', 'Netherlands',
                 'Switzerland', 'Australia', 'Singapore', 'Japan', 'Israel'; any other country
                 returns no_match. NOTE: UK tickers use GB: prefix but country param is 'UK'.

country.description: 'US','Canada','UK','Germany','France','Spain','Italy','Netherlands','Switzerland','Australia','Singapore','Japan', or 'Israel' (default: US); these are the only markets with a list, each list covers one market, and any other country returns no_match. There is no global list: when no market is named, use 'US' and say the list covers US stocks. UK tickers are returned with a 'GB:' prefix but the country value is still 'UK'.
country.title: Country

sector.description: Sector filter: technology, financial, healthcare, energy, utilities, industrials, materials, consumerdefensive, consumercyclical, services (default: all sectors). This feed files oil & gas under its Utilities sector, so 'energy' and 'utilities' return the same rows: oil & gas companies and power utilities together, all labelled 'Utilities'.
sector.title: Sector

name: get_top_rated_stocks
